authority: remediation lead only; this record does not assert product-owner authority, revoke an owner decision, or publish an acceptance artifact

finding.title: Published Batch B acceptance chain does not meet the frozen owner-approval contract
evidence: The frozen Batch B strategy requires a tool-generated approval event/message ID, a conversation/thread ID, and an approval event later than review before acceptance publication (test-strategy-batch-b.md §9).
product-owner-acceptance-batch-b.json has no conversation or thread identifier and records 2026-07-21T00:00:00Z, before the bound candidate publication commit.
The local-provenance direction permits truthful unavailable provider fields for role receipts; it does not waive authentic, ordered product-owner approval.

gate_disposition.reason: The evidence packages, V16 truth gate, and V11 review do not cure missing authentic, ordered product-owner approval. Existing lifecycle artifacts are preserved as historical evidence and may not be consumed while this stop-loss is active.

required_owner_action: A human product owner must provide a later, authentic approval bound to the exact candidate and review hashes, including the approval event/message and conversation or thread identifier required by the frozen strategy.

After that approval, an authorized lifecycle role must publish an additive supersession chain and rerun the current integrity gates and a fresh independent review before any candidate or accepted manifest can be consumed.
Do not mutate the existing candidate, acceptance, or accepted manifest in place.
prohibited_actions: Do not infer or fabricate browser, provider, conversation, approval, or human-authorization provenance.
Do not treat the acceptance timestamp disclaimer as a waiver of the frozen ordered-approval requirement.
Do not owner-accept or publish an accepted manifest under remediation authority.
